label: CORRECTION — APPENDED, ORIGINAL UNCHANGED
supersedes_scope: one field per affected object; every other value in 0002 stands

defect.what: Two objects recorded their identity as 'carried forward from ?' instead of naming the record the identifier came from.
defect.why: The generator read the source record's identifier from a field inside the record. Snapshot 0001 arrived frozen from an external capture and carries no record_id field of its own -- its identifier is the one the LEDGER attested when it was committed -- so the lookup fell through to a placeholder.
defect.severity: Provenance only. No probability, geometry, timestamp, refusal or object identifier is affected: the identifiers carried forward are correct and the stated BASIS for carrying them (identical NHC name string) is correct. What was lost is which record they were carried from.

affected.as_recorded: carried forward from ?: identical NHC name string
affected.corrected_to: carried forward from record 0001: identical NHC name string

affected.as_recorded: carried forward from ?: identical NHC name string
affected.corrected_to: carried forward from record 0001: identical NHC name string

fix.code: scripts/genesis-watch/capture.py::object_id_for now resolves prior record identifiers through the ledger rather than through a field inside the record.
fix.original_record: 0002 is NOT edited. Its bytes and its integrity hash are unchanged, and this record does not invalidate it.

append_rule: This correction is itself immutable. The contract is append-only in both directions: a frozen state is never rewritten, and neither is its correction.
